verdict.rationale: Replit docs mention a 'new space that allows you to explore and tweak designs visually, and then apply them directly to your app' and describe iterating on 'layouts, components, and experiences,' suggesting some direct visual manipulation capability distinct from prompt-based editing. However, there is no detailed documentation of selecting a specific element and editing its text/style/layout inline, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit walkthrough of click-to-select element editing, confirmation that style/layout/text changes apply without a prompt, independent user corroboration of this visual editor's behavior.
